description: This Java class defines the BlockNamespaceResponse, a response object for namespace blocking commands within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for instantiation, JSON deserialization, and header management.

classes.name: BlockNamespaceResponse
classes.description: A final class representing the response to a namespace block command, capable of JSON deserialization and header management.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of BlockNamespaceResponse with specified namespace, resourceType, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a BlockNamespaceResponse from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new BlockNamespaceResponse with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Checks if another object is an instance of BlockNamespaceResponse.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
